ConfigVersion.description:
Each package is written against a specific version of the configuration schema which represents a package framework generation.
A generational change might require changes to the package configuration file.
Therefor this field is mandatory and must be set to the current schema version.

ScriptAuthor.description: The packager who create this configuration and the associated deployment script.

ScriptDate.description:
The date the deploy script file was created.
Must be a date of the format: dd/MM/yyyy.
ScriptDate.markdownDescription:
The date the deploy script file was created.

Must be a date of the format: `dd/MM/yyyy`.

InventoryID.description:
An identifier used for internal tracking. Is used by some deployment systems.
Neo follows the following format:
* First digit of the author first name
* First digit of the author last name
* Last digit of the author name
* Eight random digits
Example: ABC12345678
InventoryID.markdownDescription:
An identifier used for internal tracking. Is used by some deployment systems.
Neo follows the following format:

* First digit of the author first name
* First digit of the author last name
* Last digit of the author name
* Eight random digits

Example: `ABC12345678`

Description.description: An optional field to describe the package. Used by some deployment systems to display additional information.

ReinstallMode.description: Based on the InstallMethod, the ReinstallMode defines the behavior when the package is already installed. MSIs can be repaired, reinstalled or installed. Other methods can only be reinstalled or installed.
ReinstallMode.markdownDescription:
Based on the `InstallMethod`, the `ReinstallMode` defines the behavior when the package is already installed.

* `MSI`: Can be repaired, reinstalled or installed.
* `Others`: Can only be reinstalled or installed.

MSIInplaceUpgradeable.description: Required property when InstallMethod is set to MSI to determine the final ReinstallMode based on the current package installation state.
MSIInplaceUpgradeable.markdownDescription: Required property when `InstallMethod` is set to `MSI` to determine the final `ReinstallMode` based on the current package installation state.

MSIDowngradeable.description: Required property when InstallMethod is set to MSI to determine the final ReinstallMode based on the current package installation state.
MSIDowngradeable.markdownDescription: Required property when `InstallMethod` is set to `MSI` to determine the final `ReinstallMode` based on the current package installation state.

SoftMigration.description: Optional configuration based tests to check if a soft migration is possible. Alternatively use Custom* functions inside the deployment script.
SoftMigration.markdownDescription: Optional configuration based tests to check if a soft migration is possible. Alternatively use `Custom*` functions inside the deployment script.

FullNameToCheck.description: The full path to a file that must exist for the soft migration to be possible.

VersionToCheck.description: Optionally, the version of the file that must match.

TestedOn.description: TestedOn is a comma separated list of operating systems and architectures the package was tested on. Required for some deployment systems.

Dependencies.description:
Dependencies is a descriptive string naming dependencies of the package.
This information is displayed in some deployment systems but has no effect on the installation.

LastChange.description:
The date of the last update to this package.
Used for tracking changes to the package on some deployment systems.
Must be a date of the format: dd/MM/yyyy.
LastChange.markdownDescription:
The date of the last update to this package.

Used for tracking changes to the package on some deployment systems.

Must be a date of the format: `dd/MM/yyyy`.

Build.description:
A mandatory revision counter for the package.
Must be increased with every change to the package where the version did not change.
Used to track the package's revision.

AppArch.description:
The architecture of the application.
Specifying '*' will allow the package to be installed on any architecture,
otherwise the system will check the architecture of the system before installing the package.

AppVendor.description:
The name of the vendor of the application.
Due to use in filesystem paths it must not contain characters that are incompatible with filesystem paths.

AppName.description:
The name of the application.
Due to use in filesystem paths it must not contain characters that are incompatible with filesystem paths.

AppVersion.description: The version of the application. Must be a valid version string.

AppRevision.description: The revision of the application. Is used for installation tracking.

AppLang.description:
Describes the language of the application as a three digit language code.
Neo42 follow the MS-LCID 3-digit language code standard.
Additionally MUI is used for multi-language applications.
AppLang.markdownDescription:
Describes the language of the application as a three digit language code.

Neo42 follow the [MS-LCID 3-digit language code](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/mem/configmgr/core/servers/deploy/install/language-packs#server-languages) standard.

In addition `MUI` is used for multi-language applications.

PackageGUID.description:
The GUID of the package in the format of {042...}.
Must be unique for each package.
This ID is used to identify the package in the package registry.
PackageGUID.markdownDescription:
The GUID of the package in the format of `{042...}`.

Must be unique for each package.

This ID is used to identify the package in the package registry.

DependentPackages.description: A list of package dependencies. Each dependency is evaluated before the package is installed.

GUID.description: The GUID of the dependent package. It is a reference to the PackageGUID of another package.
GUID.markdownDescription: The GUID of the dependent package. It is a reference to the `PackageGUID` of another package.

DesiredState.description: The desired state of the dependent package.

OnConflict.description: The action that should be taken if the desired state of the dependent package conflicts with the current state.

ErrorMessage.description: DependentPackages.ErrorMessage is optional and must be a string.

RegPackagesKey.description: The key name for the package registry. This key is rooted in HKLM\Software\
RegPackagesKey.markdownDescription: The root key name for the package registry. This key is rooted in `HKLM\Software\`

UninstallDisplayName.description: The display name of the package that will be shown in the system control settings.

AppRootFolder.description:
The filesystem path to the package storage.
If not rooted the path is relative to program data.
Will be expanded to the full path upon initialization.
On conflict with existing folders, a name extension will be added.

App.description:
A subdirectory of AppRootFolder where the package is stored.
Will be expanded to the full path upon initialization. The path must not be rooted.

UninstallOld.description: Determines if the package and its related predecessor packages should be uninstalled before installing the new package.

Reboot.description: Determine how reboots are handled. Default will respect the application response.

UserPartOnInstallation.description: Defines if the user installation routines should be enabled.

UserPartOnUninstallation.description: Defines if the user uninstallation routines should be enabled.

UserPartRevision.description:
An ActiveSetup compatible revision string.
Must be a date of the format YYYY,MM,DD,HH.
Used for determining if the user part should be executed.
Each change to the user part must increase this value.
UserPartRevision.markdownDescription:
An ActiveSetup compatible revision string.

Must be a date of the format `YYYY,MM,DD,HH`.

Used for determining if the user part should be executed.

Each change to the user part must increase this value.

HidePackageUninstallButton.description: Determines if the uninstall button on the package's entry in the system control settings should be hidden.

HidePackageUninstallEntry.description: Determines if the package's entry in the system control settings should be hidden.

DisplayVersion.description: If set, this value will be used for installation and soft migration detection instead of AppVersion. An attempt is made to parse the value as a version string, but if it fails, the value will be used as is in a string comparison.

InstallerVersion.description: A purely informational field that can be used to track the version of the installer. This field is not used by the framework.

UninstallKey.description: The base field for the application uninstall key detection. The behavior can be modified with the accompanying properties.

UninstallKeyIsDisplayName.description: Determines that the UninstallKey property represent the display name of an uninstall key.
UninstallKeyIsDisplayName.markdownDescription: Determines that the `UninstallKey` property represent the display name of an uninstall key.

UninstallKeyContainsWildCards.description: If set to true, wildcards will be evaluated.

UninstallKeyContainsExpandVariables.description: Determines that the UninstallKey property contains expandable variables.
UninstallKeyContainsExpandVariables.markdownDescription: Determines that the `UninstallKey` property contains expandable variables.

DisplayNamesToExcludeFromAppSearches.description: List of display names to exclude from app searches.

InstallLocation.description: The rooted path where the application will be installed to. Will be used as fallback to calculate the application's size.

InstLogFile.description: The name of the installation log file for for the given InstallMethod. This does not affect the toolkit log file name.
InstLogFile.markdownDescription: The name of the installation log file for for the given `InstallMethod`. This does not affect the toolkit log file name.

UninstLogFile.description: The name of the uninstallation log file for for the given InstallMethod. This does not affect the toolkit log file name.
UninstLogFile.markdownDescription: The name of the uninstallation log file for for the given `InstallMethod`. This does not affect the toolkit log file name.

InstFile.description: A path to the installation file. If not rooted the DirFiles path will be used as root.
InstFile.markdownDescription: A path to the installation file. If not rooted the `DirFiles` path will be used as root.

InstPara.description:
An argument string that will be passed to the installation.
Replacements for '%LogFile%', '%DirFiles%' and '%DirSupportFiles%' are available that will be replaced when the installation is started pointing to the full path of the property.
InstPara.markdownDescription:
An argument string that will be passed to the installation.

Replacements for `%LogFile%`, `%DirFiles%` and `%DirSupportFiles%` are available that will be replaced when the installation is started pointing to the full path of the property.

AppendInstParaToDefaultParameters.description: Determines if the parameters will be appended to the InstallMethod's default parameters defined in the toolkit configuration.
AppendInstParaToDefaultParameters.markdownDescription: Determines if the parameters will be appended to the `InstallMethod`'s default parameters defined in the toolkit configuration.

AcceptedInstallExitCodes.description: A comma separated list of accepted install exit codes. Must not contain values from AcceptedInstallRebootCodes. Supports '*' as wildcard.
AcceptedInstallExitCodes.markdownDescription: A comma separated list of accepted install exit codes. Must not contain values from `AcceptedInstallRebootCodes`. Supports `*` as wildcard.

AcceptedInstallRebootCodes.description: A comma separated list of accepted install reboot codes. Must not contain values from AcceptedInstallExitCodes. Supports '*' as wildcard.
AcceptedInstallRebootCodes.markdownDescription: A comma separated list of accepted install reboot codes. Must not contain values from `AcceptedInstallExitCodes`. Supports `*` as wildcard.

UninstFile.description: A path to the uninstallation file. If not rooted the DirFiles path will be used as root.

UninstPara.description:
An argument string that will be passed to the uninstallation.
Replacements for '%LogFile%', '%DirFiles%' and '%DirSupportFiles%' are available that will be replaced when the uninstallation is started pointing to the full path of the property.
UninstPara.markdownDescription:
An argument string that will be passed to the uninstallation.

Replacements for `%LogFile%`, `%DirFiles%` and `%DirSupportFiles%` are available that will be replaced when the uninstallation is started pointing to the full path of the property.

AppendUninstParaToDefaultParameters.description: Determines if the parameters will be appended to the UninstallMethod's default parameters defined in the toolkit configuration.
AppendUninstParaToDefaultParameters.markdownDescription: Determines if the parameters will be appended to the `UninstallMethod`'s default parameters defined in the toolkit configuration.

AcceptedUninstallExitCodes.description: A comma separated list of accepted uninstall exit codes. Must not contain values from AcceptedUninstallRebootCodes. Supports '*' as wildcard.
AcceptedUninstallExitCodes.markdownDescription: A comma separated list of accepted uninstall exit codes. Must not contain values from `AcceptedUninstallRebootCodes`. Supports `*` as wildcard.

AcceptedUninstallRebootCodes.description: A comma separated list of accepted uninstall reboot codes. Must not contain values from AcceptedUninstallExitCodes. Supports '*' as wildcard.
AcceptedUninstallRebootCodes.markdownDescription: A comma separated list of accepted uninstall reboot codes. Must not contain values from `AcceptedUninstallExitCodes`. Supports `*` as wildcard.

AppKillProcesses.description: List of processes that block the deployment from proceeding. Process handling will be determined by the user configuration in the Setup.cfg
AppKillProcesses.markdownDescription: List of processes that block the deployment from proceeding. Process handling will be determined by the user configuration in the `Setup.cfg`

Description.description: If specified, will be shown in place of the process name in the user interface.

TestConditionsPreSetupSuccessCheck.description:
TestConditionsPreSetupSuccessCheck allows to evaluate conditions before the setup is executed.
It is also used to evaluate post installation conditions.
TestConditionsPreSetupSuccessCheck.markdownDescription:
`TestConditionsPreSetupSuccessCheck` allows to evaluate conditions before the setup is executed.

It is also used to evaluate post installation conditions.

CommonDesktopShortcutsToDelete.description:
A list of desktop shortcuts that might be created by the deployment that should additionally be deleted.
Requires the path relative to the common desktop directory.

CommonStartMenuShortcutsToCopyToCommonDe.description:
A list of start menu shortcuts that should be copied to the common desktop after installation.
They will be removed upon uninstallation.

Source.description: The relative path from the common start menu directory to the shortcut to copy.

TargetName.description: An optional alternative name for the shortcut on the common desktop.

UninstallKeysToHide.description: A list of of uninstall key search patterns that will be hidden from the system control settings.

KeyName.description: The key name to hide. This property can be expanded with variables.

Is64Bit.description: Determines in which registry view the key can be found.

KeyNameIsDisplayName.description: If set to true, the key name will be evaluated as a display name. This property can be expanded with variables.

KeyNameContainsWildCards.description: If set to true, wildcards will be evaluated. This property can be expanded with variables.

DisplayNamesToExcludeFromHiding.description: List of display names to exclude from hiding.

PackageSpecificVariablesRaw.description: A list of pre-defined variables that can be used in the package configuration. These variables will be exported to the PackageVariables property.

ExpandVariables.description: Determines if the value should be expanded with other variables.

DeployMethod.description:
One of the framework supported deployment methods. Each method contains its own built-in logic.
If the desired method is not listed, choose either Setup or none.
* Setup will call the specified installation file with the specified parameters.
* none will not run any built-in deployment logic.
DeployMethod.markdownDescription:
One of the framework supported deployment methods.

If the desired method is not listed, choose either Setup or none.

* `Setup` will call the specified installation file with the specified parameters.
* `None` will not run any built-in deployment logic.

TotalSecondsToWaitFor.description: A timeout in seconds for the test conditions to be successful.

ProcessOperator.description: Determines if all or any of the ProcessesToWaitFor conditions must be successful.
ProcessOperator.markdownDescription: Determines if all or any of the `ProcessesToWaitFor` conditions must be successful.

ShouldExist.description: Switch to determine if the process should be running or not.

RegKeyOperator.description: Determines if all or any of the RegKeysToWaitFor conditions must be successful.
RegKeyOperator.markdownDescription: Determines if all or any of the `RegKeysToWaitFor` conditions must be successful.

KeyPath.description: The path to the registry key.

ValueName.description: If set, the KeyPath must contain this value.

ValueData.description: If set, the ValueName must contain this data.

ShouldExist.description: Switch to determine if the conditions should be met or not.
